evals.prompt: レビューが3つ溜まってるけど今日はもう無理。TASK-7 のレビューは navigator-list.sh の途中まで見た。一旦離脱するので、明日再開しやすいようにしといて。
evals.expected_output: Lands in-flight work on a branch, records the review's concrete resume point into TASK-7 via the backlog CLI, handles the missing remote gracefully, reports what was parked/recorded, no destructive ops.

assertions.text: Uncommitted changes are committed on a branch, not left dangling or committed onto the default branch
A concrete resume point (which file, how far, what's left) is written to the Backlog task via the CLI, not vaguely 'continue review'
The missing git remote is detected and handled gracefully (noted), not treated as a hard failure that abandons the ritual
No destructive git op (merge to main, force push, delete) is performed without confirmation
No stray summary file (*.md etc.) is created outside the Backlog record

evals.prompt: デバッグ中だけど中断する。queue-view の ⚠ が出ない件を追ってて、classify_pane_wait は正しいところまで確認した。次は get_wait_state の tmux 分岐を疑ってる。店じまいして。
evals.expected_output: Records the debug hypotheses (classify_pane_wait cleared, next suspect get_wait_state's tmux branch) to the Backlog task, keeps the real fix, discards the easily-reproducible debug scratch, no destructive ops.

assertions.text: The debug state (tested/ruled-out hypotheses and the next place to look) is recorded to the Backlog task via the CLI
The reproducible debug scratch (_debug_scratch.sh) is discarded, not committed or left behind
The real fix (queue-view.sh change) is preserved via commit, not lost
No destructive git op is performed without confirmation

evals.prompt: セッション閉じる。特に途中の作業はないけど念のため。
evals.expected_output: Recognizes the clean tree, does not invent Backlog tasks or create files, gives a short 'nothing to park, safe to close' report.

assertions.text: Recognizes there is nothing meaningful in flight (clean working tree)
Does NOT create a Backlog task (no 'task create' call)
Does NOT create any new file for the sake of recording
Gives a concise 'safe to close' confirmation rather than over-recording
